I’ll read the named files and relevant contracts, then return actionable findings. I won’t open other cases, questions, or gold data.

I’m using the Council review skill within your read-only scope. HEAD matches the baseline; the checkout has changes in the selected record and plan. The plan says measurements are pending, so this review will assess the design and its risks without claiming an improvement.

The clearest contract issue is in `read_note` guidance: search returns a passage offset, but the schema examples name only zero, heading starts, and continuation offsets. I also found design ambiguities in the efficiency metric, incomplete-pair handling, and estimator diagnostic that should be resolved before dispatch.

- **Medium — Efficiency acceptance is underspecified.** [Plan:29](/Users/evokessler/repos/brn-agent-e-256/docs/work/active/windows-ci-portability/search-256.md:29) does not define the median’s population, cumulative input accounting, or treatment of incomplete pairs. **Fix:** freeze the aggregation before baseline; count input across all HTTP attempts, including retries and summaries; retain failed pairs as failures and missing usage as unknown. Define model requests and tool invocations separately.

- **Medium — R7 projection needs an explicit no-write oracle.** [Plan:15](/Users/evokessler/repos/brn-agent-e-256/docs/work/active/windows-ci-portability/search-256.md:15) says to remap safety checks and add no-writes without defining the assertion. Normal execution persists Messages/Runs, so whole-database equality would be unsuitable. **Fix:** freeze a projection-specific evaluator that checks prohibited mutation calls, candidates/operations, and canonical knowledge changes while allowing expected host bookkeeping. Preserve private-exposure checks.

- **Medium — Estimator comparison needs distinct, reproducible mechanisms.** [Plan:37–42](/Users/evokessler/repos/brn-agent-e-256/docs/work/active/windows-ci-portability/search-256.md:37) names whole and usage-anchored estimates but leaves their construction unspecified. **Fix:** record whole-request estimation separately from an observed-usage anchor plus subsequent request changes. Define anchor/request alignment and reset rules for compaction, history replacement, account, route and model changes. Without observed usage, report anchored accuracy as unknown; retain shadow-only admission behavior.

- **Low — Tool guidance obscures the direct search-to-passage path.** [Search result contract:132](/Users/evokessler/repos/brn-agent-e-256/crates/brn-ai/src/threads_search.rs:132) supplies a matching passage offset, while [read_note schema:745](/Users/evokessler/repos/brn-agent-e-256/crates/brn-ai/src/threads.rs:745) and [description:864](/Users/evokessler/repos/brn-agent-e-256/crates/brn-ai/src/threads.rs:864) emphasize zero, heading starts and continuation offsets. **Fix:** explicitly document using the search result’s exact version/start with `section=false`; reserve `section=true` for advertised heading starts. Preserve continuation, citation and stale-version requirements.

**Recommendation:** measure baseline first. If traces show redundant `read_records` calls between search and passage reading, test only the direct-passage guidance clarification above. Keep section-first behavior, compact catalogs and retrieval implementation unchanged; use the fixed independent grader for acceptance, separately from Council.

**Score: 7/10** for design readiness; improvement remains unmeasured.
